limitations: RED had to deselect four cases that on the OLD tools start the forbidden full coverage suite; those four were executed for real in the GREEN concentrated node. Deselection is recorded, not counted as a pass.

During RED the old final_ratchet default did recurse (run_coverage_gates tests re-invoking run_coverage_gates) and hit the 900s tool timeout; all lane processes were killed by an exact `_g2` + `revenue-forecast` match, and processes belonging to other harness lanes were left running.

In this worktree pre_push_gate needs FF_V2_CODE_ROOT / CWP_V2_CODE_ROOT exported because the lane checkout has no filing-fetch/company-wiki siblings next to it (tests/test_p5_source_default_cli_e2e.py::_env_roots' pre-existing env override). The main checkout needs no such variable.

Numeric coverage / mypy / capacity values are diagnostics only and no longer decide qualification; real tool failures, pytest non-zero exits (including rc=2 collection errors), launch failures, timeouts, illegal configuration and explicitly supplied bad SHAs still fail.
No full-suite nightly/per-commit run was added; durations and counts above are measured facts with no numeric gate.
